flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 32, P/B 11.1. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 96% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -2% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.61) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
National Kharif sowing declined by 22.7% year-on-year by the end of June 2026 due to cumulative rainfall being nearly 40% below normal.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Rainfall improved in early July, driving a recovery in sowing, farmer sentiment, and fertilizer off-take.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 72% vs profit 56% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Management cited West Asia geopolitical tensions, supply-chain disruptions, volatile raw material prices, and uneven monsoons as headwinds in H1 FY27.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite geopolitical tensions in West Asia, supply-chain disruptions, volatile raw material prices and uneven monsoon distribution, we delivered record H1 revenue of ₹1,235 crore, registering a growth of 23% year-on-year." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Industry-wide production dropped 28% year-on-year in April-May 2026 due to raw material availability and logistics constraints.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Geopolitical issues around the Strait of Hormuz led to higher freight costs, delayed vessel movements, and higher procurement costs.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Dec) are still in the cycle.
